title: feat: reduced VAT rate per line in total_incl_tax
changes: `total_incl_tax` applies to each line the rate of its `vat` key: `"standard"` (20%) or `"reduced"` (5.5%); without the key, the line stays at 20%.
The incl. tax total is summed without rounding, then rounded once to the cent on the total (commercial rounding, ROUND_HALF_UP).
Five tests added in `tests/test_totals.py`, one per acceptance criterion; no existing test modified.
why: Some invoice lines (books, food) are at the reduced rate of 5.5%, while `total_incl_tax` applied 20% to everything (INV-231).
plan: Write one test per acceptance criterion and see them fail (4 failures out of 5: criterion 3 describes the current behaviour).
Add the table of rates and the reading of a line's rate, with `ValueError` on an unknown key.
Compute the incl. tax total line by line without rounding, round once on the total.
